title: System backup D-owned Admin mutation business bodies

retry_of_public_id.x-runtime-availability: non-null currently returns not_ready until same-transaction retry admission and persistence are implemented

BackupCreateRequest.x-normalization: Apply omitted purpose=acceptance and retry=null; null purpose is invalid. Treat requested_parts as a set, ordered mysql,redis,object_storage,workspace,deployment_resources,secret_bundle before JCS. Hash exactly the normalized business body.
BackupCreateRequest.x-decoding: Reject duplicate decoded keys, invalid UTF-8, non-scalar Unicode, unknown or case-aliased keys and trailing JSON. Request/auth/idempotency transport is forbidden in the business body. Maximum input is 65536 bytes.

retry_of_public_id.x-runtime-availability: non-null currently returns not_ready until same-transaction retry admission and persistence are implemented

PreflightCreateRequest.x-runtime-availability: catalog_import currently returns not_ready until canonical catalog source admission is delivered; it is never resolved as a local backup
PreflightCreateRequest.x-normalization: Apply omitted preflight_mode=production_readonly and retry=null. All other fields are required; null mode is invalid. Encode the normalized business body as JCS.
PreflightCreateRequest.x-decoding: Reject duplicate decoded keys, invalid UTF-8, non-scalar Unicode, unknown or case-aliased keys and trailing JSON. Target ref is an opaque registered identifier, never a DSN/path/URL or observed target descriptor. Maximum input is 65536 bytes.

CleanupRequest.x-invariant: non-null retry operation must be a failed cleanup for the same target and endpoint; only unfinished resource lifecycle steps may rerun

x-invariants: rollback creates a new monotonic config version and never reactivates the old row
change_reason is non-null and non-empty when server-side comparison finds a protection reduction
strong_auth_proof is authentication transport owned by A and is excluded from this business body and request hash

FinalizationResolutionRequest.x-invariant: server reloads the unique unresolved action and registered immutable proof, verifies owner/expiry/signature and derives the result without a live-provider hidden prerequisite

OwnershipResolutionRequest.x-invariant: server derives the staging or restore-resource transition from the registered owner-matched proof and never accepts a client-selected terminal state

x-invariants: server reads the current hold and protected-set state before selecting operate versus destructive permission
reason is non-null and non-empty and recent strong authentication is required when releasing the last recovery-point hold
a successful release does not delete immediately and only permits a later independent prune dry-run

PromotionCreateRequest.x-invariant: matrix and all acceptance/health/cleanup/source-link facts are server-derived in one transaction before active-row CAS

PromotionRevokeRequest.x-invariant: matrix_key is the typed path parameter and the server verifies it against the current installation before revocation

PruneConfirmationRequest.x-invariant: server consumes the A-owned recent strong-auth proof and creates the actor-bound confirmation in the same transaction

PruneExecuteRequest.x-invariant: confirmation consumption, complete candidate/guard recheck and first deleting CAS are one transaction even when validation fails after proof verification

PruneRetryRequest.x-invariant: retry uses a new A-owned strong-auth proof and only the original immutable candidate set; it cannot add or recreate successful items

x-owner-boundaries.A: strong_auth_proof and nonce schema remain pending_owner_submission and are not defined here
x-owner-boundaries.B: staging and restore-resource provider identity fields remain in B-owned resource contracts and are not accepted in these request bodies
x-owner-boundaries.C: provider evidence payload and external-action/provider internals remain in C/A-owned contracts; D accepts only registered public IDs
